room_rent.note: Room rent limit not stated in wording; sub-limits table implies differential billing applies. Refer policy schedule.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient benefit but no specific cap stated in wording.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on all admissible claims in non-network hospitals; 10% co-pay for insured above 60 years irrespective of network/non-network.

sub_limits.note: Same sub-limit values as Secure Supreme: Cataract ₹40k/eye, Hysterectomy ₹55k, Gall bladder ₹55k, Piles ₹40k, PTCA ₹1.5L, CABG ₹2L, TKR ₹1.5L, THR ₹1.5L and more.

ped_waiting.note: Assumed 24-month PED wait as top-tier plan; policy states 36 or 24 months depending on plan.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% or 25% per claim-free year up to 100% depending on plan. Enhanced CB up to 150% available as optional add-on.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured is an optional cover; triggers after original SI + CB exhausted.

pre_hosp.note: Period not stated in wording; refer policy schedule.

post_hosp.note: Period not stated in wording; refer policy schedule.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to basic Sum Insured; OPD/day-care AYUSH excluded.

notable_exclusions: STDs/HIV, dental (non-accident), OPD treatment, treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, prosthetics/external devices, refractive error <7.5D
optional_riders: Reload of Sum Insured, Enhanced Cumulative Bonus (up to 150%), Waiver of Sub-limits
